name: Alice
source:
Jack's childhood friend whom she was stuck together in a cell with until they were saved by [url=/c68683]Tsuu[/url]. Along their escape way however, Alice's abilities as a Chishiki Girl awakened.

She loves Jack and such, is greatly concerned over him turning into a nightmare so she often tries to talk to him, even if he possibly doesn't understand what Alice is telling him.
